Cody Davis, Mesa County Commissioner for District 1

Get to know your County Commissioner

 

Cody Davis, County Commissioner for District 1

Cody Davis is a husband, father, business owner, and fifth-generation native of the Grand Valley. He and his wife, Alana, have five beautiful children, three of whom they have adopted through their many years of foster parenting.

Cody is a loving family man and a successful community leader. He brings both a principled and common-sense approach to local government.

Current assignments

County Commissioner Cody Davis represents the county on these boards and commissions

Voting Member (Boards & Committees)

  • Associated Governments of Northwest Colorado (AGNC) — Chair
  • Colorado Counties, Inc. (CCI) —Legislative Representative (authorized to sign official BOCC letters)
  • Grand Junction Regional Airport Authority
  • Grand Valley Regional Transportation Committee (GVRTC)

Liaison (Non-Voting/Representative)

  • Grand Junction Regional Air Service Alliance
  • Building Advisory Group

Statutory Boards (All Commissioners — Voting Members)

  • Board of County Commissioners
  • Board of Human Services (includes Mesa County Workforce)
  • Board of Equalization
  • Board of Special Districts

Leadership and community service experience

  • Served as Chair of the Grand Valley Drainage District
  • Served as Chair of the Housing and Building Association of Western Colorado
  • Church Board
  • Member of numerous round table efforts, master planning and land use committees

Connect with Commissioner Davis

Email: Cody.Davis@mesacounty.us
